entries.summary: Five resilience patterns for production Python: retry with exponential backoff (tenacity/stamina), circuit breaker (pybreaker/circuitbreaker), graceful degradation (layered fallback hierarchy), timeout boundaries (asyncio.timeout/httpx), and bulkhead isolation (ThreadPoolExecutor/Semaphore). Includes wrong/right code examples, AI agent anti-patterns, recommended defaults, and a combined production wrapper.
